lines.en: Six desserts. Three rounds. One card at a time.
lines.zh: 六种甜点，三轮，每次一张。

lines.en: Sweet Carousel. Pick one, pass it on.
lines.zh: 甜点转盘。选一张，传下去。

lines.en: Eight cards each. Everyone picks one together.
lines.zh: 每人八张，大家一起选一张。

lines.en: Pair, triple, full plate, sampler. Every leftover counts.
lines.zh: 一对、三层、满盘、拼盘。收尾也算分。

lines.en: Pass left, then right, then left. Three rounds.
lines.zh: 传左，传右，再传左。一共三轮。

lines.en: Hot-seat with a privacy cover, or solo against four AI levels.
lines.zh: 传设备有隐私遮罩，单人可打四档 AI。

lines.en: A phone joins over Wi-Fi. Each device gets only its own hand.
lines.zh: 手机连同一 Wi-Fi 加入，每台设备只收到自己的手牌。

lines.en: Offline, no account, no ads. Sweet Carousel.
lines.zh: 离线、无账号、无广告。甜点转盘。
